# cypress-rerun-failed

A Cypress plugin and CLI tool to automatically rerun failed spec files from a previous run.  
Supports auto-rerun in CI, custom browser/headed mode, and retry attempts.

---

## Features

- 🔁 Rerun only failed Cypress spec files
- ⚡ CLI support: `--browser`, `--headed`, `--retries`
- 🔄 Optional auto-rerun in CI via environment variables
- 🖥️ Works with Mochawesome JSON reports
- 📂 Saves failed spec list in `cypress/failed-specs.json`
